Welcome — I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

A few things I can do for you:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there), and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser. I keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I'll ask you when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I go by diego-agent and I'm neither male nor female — tell me if you'd rather call me something else.

What would you like to start with?
